breach: Elevated card block rate after an incremental retrain

data.title: Elevated card block rate after an incremental retrain
data.description: An incremental retrain shifted the score distribution and the block rate reached 2.4 times the trailing average. The circuit breaker suspended automatic blocking within 6 minutes and the model was rolled back to the previous version.
data.impact: Approximately 180 legitimate transactions declined; all customers contacted and blocks reversed.
data.resolution: Rolled back; champion-challenger gate added before any retrain is promoted.

summary: warning: Injected instruction in a scanned onboarding document

data.title: Injected instruction in a scanned onboarding document
data.description: A scanned document contained text instructing the agent to record the file as requiring no further documents. The indirect injection filter stripped it and the attempt was logged. No case note was affected.
data.impact: None; the filter held and the case proceeded normally.
data.resolution: Probe added to the regression suite; filter coverage extended to document footers.
